title:

scan_hint: Hold a transit card against the back of your phone
empty_history: Tap a card to see recent transactions
local_only: Card data stays on this device
sync_hint: Tap the same card again to update its balance and history
font_hint: Uses your device font and text size
only_colors: Changes the colors while keeping the same layout
unsupported_card: This card does not expose supported transit balance data.
invalid_card_data: The card returned incomplete or invalid data. Please try again.
card_moved: The card moved away. Hold it still against the phone and try again.
read_failed: Reading failed. Remove other cards and hold one card close to the NFC antenna.
nfc_missing: This device has no available NFC reader
amount_note: Changes are inferred only from consecutive card balances. An unavailable change is shown as a dash. Merchant names are not stored in these records.
records_limit: Only records read from the card are shown. Older card records may have been overwritten. Remembering a card preserves previously read records on this device.
partial_history: Some history blocks were unavailable. The balance was read successfully.
card_art_hint: Artwork and names only affect the display in this app. They do not change the physical card or its issuer.
no_cards_hint: Read a physical transit card, then choose to remember it.
